summary: P0 fixes for (1) Markdown rendering in AI chat, (2) narrative-aware autofill with missing_critical + image_assignments, and (3) PATCH /fields accepting image-dict values — all verified. Backend: new suite /app/backend/tests/test_p13_markdown_narrative.py (5 tests, 4 pass, 1 skipped as documented). Frontend: FAQ chat's greeting containing '**KırCan Danışmanlık**' renders as <strong> with data-testid='assistant-markdown' present and no literal ** in output; user bubbles remain plain-text (whitespace-pre-wrap, no markdown parsing). One real Claude Vision call executed for autofill and one real Claude SSE call for the user_template narrative chat.

minor.issue: For a single tapu-like PNG with no clearly identifiable 'cephe' photo, Claude did not populate image_map; image_assignments came back as []. This is expected LLM behaviour, but consider adding a soft heuristic (e.g. if exactly 1 image_slot + exactly 1 image upload, auto-assign) so the feature is discoverable during demos. Response contract remains correct — arrays exist even when empty.

System prompt tells Claude to return image_map entries keyed by 'upload_id', but the image_file_manifest already exposes upload_ids. Sometimes Claude returns the filename instead of upload_id — recommend also accepting {filename: 'x.png', field_key: 'slot'} entries in the image_map post-processor (resolve filename→upload_id) for better recall.

action_items: Optional: fallback image_map matching (filename or single-slot single-image auto-assign) to improve UX when Claude omits image_map.
Optional: accept image_map entries by filename in autofill_chat_from_attachments (currently only upload_id).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2644 lines; the newly added narrative + image_map logic further inflates autofill_chat_from_attachments (330+ lines). Consider extracting `_build_autofill_prompt`, `_reconcile_autofill_wallet` and `_apply_image_map` helpers to keep the endpoint readable.

Markdown rendering: ChatPanel MessageBubble properly restricts ReactMarkdown to assistant bubbles; user bubbles still use whitespace-pre-wrap. Consider adding rehype-sanitize (react-markdown does not sanitize by default) to defend against ']]>'-style injection or embedded HTML if Claude ever streams raw HTML.

_build_system_prompt narrative_hint is only appended when narrative_fields is non-empty — good. However, the ternary `f"...{narrative_fields}" if narrative_fields else ""` sits inside an f-string block that is not surrounded by parentheses, so any future addition to that block risks accidentally always evaluating the truthy branch. Suggest hoisting narrative_hint to its own variable before the return.

autofill_chat_from_attachments: image_assignments are computed but never written back to db — relying entirely on frontend to PATCH them. Consider adding a `dry_run` flag / auto-apply option, or at least logging when the frontend does NOT confirm within N minutes so we can surface orphaned suggestions in analytics.

success_rate.backend: 4/5 pass (80%); 1 skip is a documented LLM-behavior skip, not a failure
success_rate.frontend: markdown rendering verified visually + programmatically (has_strong=True, raw_bold_asterisks_in_text=False)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_P13 user_template docs (TEST_p13_ut_*) with narrative textarea + image slot; TEST_p13_tapu.png upload; ~4 test chats. All cleaned up via module-scoped autouse fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_p13_markdown_narrative.py — module-scoped fixtures with autouse cleanup; contains exactly 2 real Claude calls (1 Vision autofill + 1 SSE). To verify markdown rendering in FAQ chat: log in with cookie session_token=test_super_admin_token, open the FAQ chat, assert `.locator('[data-testid="assistant-markdown"]').first` contains <strong> and no literal '**'. The greeting itself contains '**KırCan Danışmanlık**' so this can be verified without sending a new (paid) message.
rca_of_the_issue: (1) Raw ** asterisks: MessageBubble previously rendered assistant text with whitespace-pre-wrap plain text. Fix uses ReactMarkdown+remark-gfm only for assistant bubbles (user bubbles kept as plain text). Verified: `KırCan Danışmanlık` in DOM, no literal '**'. (2) Short-only autofill: _build_system_prompt (user_tpl) + autofill's system prompt now enumerate narrative_keys and explicitly demand 3–8-sentence paragraphs plus a missing_critical array for gaps; response contract adds image_assignments+missing_critical always-arrays. (3) PATCH /fields with image dict: patch_chat_fields uses `if v in (None, ''): pop` — a dict v is never equal to None/'', so it correctly falls through to `new_fields[k] = v`. Verified by round-trip create→PATCH→GET on both konut chat and cleared via `clear[]`. (4) SSE regression: user_template chat with narrative fields streams cleanly (delta+done events, non-empty output); the `narrative_hint if narrative_fields else ''` conditional does not raise.
